jess: Quick Q — where's the saved search for model=redwood-v2 errors in ap-sg for /generate? seeing a spike in 5xxs around 14:10 UTC

omar: there is one but it's named differently. try Saved Views > 'model_route_errors_ap' or use this query:

omar: ```org:acadia model:redwood-v2 route:/generate region:ap-sg status:[500 TO 599] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 500```

laura: also check the infra errors dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/infra/errors?view=ap-sg-models :eyes:

jess: thanks — can't find that saved view in my list, maybe permissions?

omar: @jess you need the team-sre role; i'll share a temporary link

omar: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/infra/errors?view=ap-sg-models&share=eyJhbGci... (link expires in 24h)

sre-bot: deploy-detect: New deployment for service inference-runtime in ap-sg at 2026-03-16T14:09Z :rotating_light:

mike: that deploy rolled back once; could be related. can someone add a saved search filtered by deploy id + model?

laura: created saved search 'acadia_redwoodv2_ap_generate_5xx' and added it to the team-sre library. you should see it now @jess :white_check_mark:

jess: I see it, running the query now. also — can we tweak the alert to ignore transient deploy spikes? it's noisy

omar: either open a ticket or quick change here: relax the alert to a 10m window and require 3x baseline. i'll make a quick rule change and ping.

omar: updated alert rule: condition -> sustained 5xx rate > 3% over 10m AND min occurrences >= 5

jess: perfect, thanks. saving logs for RCA.

mike: FYI i've added the saved query id to the incident runbook

laura: tagging this thread in the runbook: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/inference-5xx

jess: closing loop — will follow up if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
